title: Allston Burr Resident Dean of Pforzheimer House Assistant Dean of Harvard College Lecturer in French
bio: I am here to advise Pforzheimer House students, to help them navigate whatever academic, residential or personal issues they may be facing and to help them get the most out of their Harvard experience. I am originally from northern Maine and lived for many years in New Hampshire before landing in the Boston area. I have a BA and MA from Dartmouth College and a PhD in French Language and Literature from Boston University. My academic interests range from Acadian and Franco-American literature to gender studies, cultural studies and student development theory. Even if you aren’t sure whether the Resident Dean’s office is the right place to come with your concern or question, please get in touch! We can help connect you with all of the many resources that are here for you at Harvard College. Community Pforzheimer House Area Residential Life Role Residential Allston Burr Resident Deans
